description: Timed freewriting sprint: wizard timer selection, hover-driven chip controls, completion board, and persistence across refresh.

workflows.name: Wizard appears on a fresh visit
steps: Clear local storage and navigate to /editor.
Verify the freewrite wizard becomes visible.
Verify timer options (5 min, 10 min, 15 min, 20 min) are present.

workflows.name: Selecting a wizard option starts a sprint
steps: From the wizard, click a duration option.
Verify the wizard hides.
Verify the sprint chip is visible with a running countdown.

workflows.name: Hovering the timer reveals pause/play
steps: Start a sprint.
Hover over the sprint chip area.
Verify a pause control fades in.
Click pause; verify the chip reads 'Paused'.
Verify the play control stays visible while paused (no hover required).
Click play; verify the countdown resumes.

workflows.name: Hovering reveals +1m which extends the timer
steps: Start a sprint.
Hover the sprint chip area.
Click the +1m control.
Verify the displayed remaining time advances by approximately one minute.

workflows.name: Stop button ends the sprint and reopens the wizard
steps: Start a sprint.
Hover the chip area and click the stop control.
Verify the sprint chip is hidden.
Verify the freewrite wizard reappears.

workflows.name: Sprint completes and board animates in
steps: Start a 5-second sprint.
Type a few sentences while the timer runs.
Wait for completion and idle detection.
Verify the board overlay becomes visible.

workflows.name: Typing exits the board and returns to editor
steps: Complete a sprint and wait for the board.
Type into the editor.
Verify the board transitions out and the typed text is present.

workflows.name: Review board button reopens the board after dismissal
steps: Complete a sprint and dismiss the board by typing.
Verify the 'Review board' chip appears.
Click it and verify the board appears again.

workflows.name: New-freewrite CTA on the board reopens the wizard
steps: Complete a sprint and wait for the board.
Click 'Start a new freewrite'.
Verify the board hides and the wizard appears.
Verify the sprint chip is hidden while the wizard is up.

workflows.name: Chip shows Done after completion even while typing
steps: Start a 5-second sprint and wait for it to expire.
Continue typing.
Verify the chip reads 'Done'.

workflows.name: Refresh during a running sprint restores the running timer
steps: Start a sprint and wait briefly.
Refresh the page.
Verify the wizard does not appear.
Verify the sprint chip shows a running countdown.

workflows.name: Refresh after completion lands directly on the board
steps: Complete a 5-second sprint and wait for the board.
Refresh the page.
Verify the board overlay is visible without the editor view appearing first.
